name: Tobishima (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tobishima village emblem in white: a winged device above a disc with a small ring.
history: Municipal flag of Tobishima, a village in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 March 1980.

features.role: Tobishima village emblem — a winged device above a disc with a small ring
